content:
erin: Planning thread for CloudCon West joint booth with OrbitEdge + AccelNode. Main asks: speaker lineup, demo fallback plan, contactless swag distribution. Who's in?
kai: Count me in. I can coordinate speakers and the demo image. Need final speaker list by Wed EOD.
donna: Marketing will need bios + headshots + PR one-liners by Tue. Also landing page copy by Fri.
miguel: Ops will own swag flow and courier drops. Proposal: QR locker at booth C7 for contactless pickup. Volunteer scans QR -> locker opens. Lock code provided by venue day-of.
erin: Love the locker idea. Can we limit 1 swag item per reg? Also option B: pre-scheduled pickup windows to avoid lines.
kai: Demo fallback: primary on AccelNode rack (GPU). Fallback 1: local CPU container (Docker image preloaded). Fallback 2: 90s recorded walkthrough + live Q&A. Moderator to call fallback.
miguel: I'll ship two boxes to venue warehouse by May 2. Locker size check pending. If locker too small we'll switch to staffed table with contactless scanner.
ops-bot: calendar: "CloudCon West: OrbitEdge + AccelNode Booth Demo" added Jun 8 13:30-14:30 PT. Dry run Jun 6 09:30 PT. Invites sent.
donna: Volunteer shifts: 13:00-14:00 lead @miguel, 14:00-15:00 backup @erin. Can OrbitEdge provide 1 volunteer?
kai: Yes, OrbitEdge will send Priya as their on-site engineer.
erin: Draft manifest for courier: 
```
- 150 sticker sleeves
- 50 device dongles (USB-C)
- 20 demo micro-appliances (boxed)
- 150 one-pager quickstarts
```
miguel: Good. Add weights/dims and packed photo. I'll also label each demo kit with owner contact.
donna: Run-of-show: slides due May 22, speaker dry run Jun 6 09:30 PT, final PDF Jun 7. Promo blast dates: May 15, May 29, Jun 6.
kai: Tech checklist: bring 2x HDMI adapters, 1x 5m HDMI cable, spare ethernet cable, local dev laptop with preloaded Docker image, and an offline shell script that boots the CPU demo in <45s.
erin: Moderator script will include a 30s fallback call and a pointer to the recorded video link. Also avoid publicizing benchmarks unless legal okays it.
miguel: Locker plan: ID C7, staging at Booth Storage A. Volunteers will use mobile UI to scan QR and open. I'll test flow during dry run.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run scheduled Jun 6 09:30 PT. Auto-notify panelists 24h prior.
donna: PR/legal note: no latency/cost numbers in external promo without approval. Use qualitative phrases.
kai: Final owners: speakers = kai, marketing = donna, swag & locker = miguel, moderator = erin, dry run = all.
erin: Thanks team. I'll DM owners a checklist and follow up on speaker confirmations. :raised_hands:
